confidence_notes: Overall low confidence. Restaurant and drink levels come from WebSearch summaries of Banyuwangi meal guides and national Indonesian cost-of-living averages. These sources are undated in places and disagree, and no pages were opened in full. Cocktail and wine have no Banyuwangi-specific data; they are scaled from Bali reports relative to beer (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine about 2.75x beer). Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with a judgmental July high-season uplift; no accommodation searches or listing checks were made. IDR figures assume roughly 17,000 IDR per USD, not separately verified. Sit-down venues may add 10 to 21 percent service and tax, only partly reflected. The FX value is from a WebSearch summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to national Indonesian averages and Java cities with similar restaurant pricing (Semarang, Medan, and a Surabaya-level restaurant index), with Bali treated as a higher-priced tourist benchmark that Banyuwangi undercuts. Lodging is judged against budget-to-mid-tier East Javan and Yogyakarta-scale tourist towns from general knowledge.
